description: PAUSED: Growtsy can't read Etsy's API right now (since 19 November 2026); this tool returns the error etsy_offline — don't retry it. Instead: etsy_seller_answer ("How do I research competitors on Etsy for free?"); the error's alternatives link Etsy's own research data. When Etsy access returns: Facts from one Etsy search: Etsy's active listing count for the phrase, the middle half and median of USD-priced listing prices (other currencies counted, not converted), tags and title phrases the listings share, and the shops behind them. No demand or saturation verdict and no search volume (Etsy's API does not provide it).
name: etsy_niche_check
title: Etsy niche facts
